chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Ibn al-Mughirah, from a man, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
When a man performs wudu (ablution), let him splash his face with water, for if he is drowsy he will be startled and awaken, and if there is cold, he will be startled and not feel the cold.
And this report does not contradict.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about splashing the face with water during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the manner of wudu (ablution), recommending that one strike or splash the face with water. It highlights a practical benefit: it helps remove drowsiness and reduces the sensation of cold during ablution.
